value.quote: no voter has an incentive to misreport if she cannot benefit
value.note: The strategyproofness definitions and the proof of Theorem 5.7 separate the true approval set A_i from a misreported A_i', and the text says voters may misreport their true preferences. In the main model the preference is represented by the approval set.

C2.4.reason: The paper uses separate notation for the true approval set A_i and the reported A_i', and says voters may misreport their true preferences, which meets the DIST criterion even though the main model identifies preference with the approval set.
